summary: Backend-only testing of IndexNow auto-ping + honest sitemap lastmod feature. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter68_seo_autoping.py with 16 tests covering sitemap structure, CMS auto-ping on create/update/delete for blog + countries, honest per-URL lastmod, auth guards on /api/seo/ping-log and /api/seo/indexnow, expo admin create auto-ping + sitemap inclusion, and regression on /api/countries, /api/services, /api/events/list, /api/robots.txt, backend log cleanliness. 16/16 passed. IndexNow pings to api.indexnow.org are live and returning ok (verified via /api/seo/ping-log result.ok=true, status 200/202).
critical_code_review_comments: seo.py admin guards raise 403 while require_admin elsewhere raises 401 — intentional (per spec '403'), but inconsistent with rest of the admin surface. Minor.
SITE is hardcoded to https://vametra.com in seo.py — correct per spec (prod host even when triggered from preview). Document this clearly if future environments need different hosts.

notify_content_change is fire-and-forget using asyncio.get_running_loop(); if ever called from a sync context (e.g. a background thread), it will log 'auto-ping skipped' but silently miss pings. Currently all call-sites are inside async routes so this is OK.

weekly_full_sweep + boot-warmup both call indexnow_submit with ALL public URLs (likely 155+). Fine for IndexNow (10k limit) but each boot of the backend will push a real-world ping burst — consider gating by a 'first-boot-of-week' marker in db to avoid spam on frequent restarts.
seed_data_creation: Test items (blog + countries CMS entries, 1 expo event) were created and cleaned up within each test. No lingering TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo listings public endpoint is /api/events/list (not /api/events). Expo admin create is /api/events/admin/create and admin delete /api/events/admin/{event_id}. Sitemap is served at /api/sitemap.xml (SEO router mounted under /api). CMS admin endpoints: /api/admin/collection/{name} supports blog, countries, products, corridors, industries, hsn_codes. Each CRUD triggers notify_content_change -> real IndexNow submission; audit log at /api/seo/ping-log (admin-gated, 403 w/o token).
